answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake: each agent must lock collateral to act, so spinning up a grove of fake identities costs real capital per node rather than being free. View the network through a prism of proof-of-cost and sybils stop paying off. Honest agents earn their stake back through verified work; cheaters forfeit it. The economic knoll they must climb grows steeper with every duplicate, making mass fake-identity attacks unprofitable instead of merely detectable.
